trust_decision.summary: A client-supplied filesystem path may be read, written or installed only if, after full canonicalization (realpath) of both the path and each declared MCP root, it equals a root or lies beneath it; decided once in McpContext.validatePath, which every path-taking tool and the context-layer file APIs route through.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names validatePath and symlink canonicalization, so the first place an engineer opens is the lexical prefix check: path.resolve(filePath) compared with path.resolve(fileURLToPath(root.uri)) at src/McpContext.ts:186-195.

fix_sites.entry_point: all path-taking tools (new helper resolveCanonicalPath, added by the fix)
Context type consumed by every tool handler
take_screenshot, take_snapshot, evaluate_script, performance_start_trace, performance_stop_trace, get_network_request, lighthouse_audit via saveFile

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For get_heapsnapshot_retainers the tool handler already calls context.validatePath (src/tools/memory.ts:145) directly above the call, so the context-layer method getHeapSnapshotRetainers needs no check of its own - a solver fixes the four sibling methods it sees validated and leaves this one, arguing the tool layer covers it.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Writing to output paths that do not exist yet - screenshots, traces, heap snapshots and network bodies are created by the tool, so the target file is usually absent. A fix that calls fs.realpath() on the checked path throws ENOENT and breaks every file-output tool; the check must resolve the nearest existing ancestor and re-append the missing tail. Second coupled behaviour: roots() appends os.tmpdir() as an implicit root, so that root must also be canonicalized (macOS /tmp -> /private/tmp) or every legitimate temp-file write is denied.

O6_input_shapes: undefined / omitted path - must still be allowed (src/McpContext.ts:179-181)
non-existent leaf file whose parent directory exists (fix.diff:367-382)
non-existent path with several missing intermediate directories - nearest existing ancestor walk (fix.diff:370-396)
relative path resolved against cwd before comparison (fix.diff:356)
path whose symlink component points outside the root - must be denied (fix.diff:72-77)
root URI that is itself a symlink - both sides canonicalized (fix.diff:69-70)
path that cannot be resolved at all (non-ENOENT error) - deny, fail closed (fix.diff:48-57)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: CLI/daemon transport: the chrome-devtools CLI sends invoke_tool over a socket to a daemon whose internal MCP client declares no roots capability, so setRoots is never called and validatePath returns early - every file-writing or file-reading tool reached this way (screenshot --filePath, upload_file --filePath, install_extension --path, ...) runs with no roots check at all.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The operator typing the CLI command is the same local user supplying the path, and MCP roots are a client-declared concept, so there is no declared root to enforce against - the legacy allow-all (src/McpContext.ts:183-185, tested at tests/McpContext.test.ts:253-257) looks like intended behaviour.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: another package/dir (src/daemon + src/bin) plus the server bootstrap src/index.ts:61-90, far from the tool handlers the report names

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Any MCP client that opens the server without declaring the roots capability (src/index.ts:61-90 only calls setRoots when the client advertises roots), which turns the whole confinement check into a no-op for all 15 path-taking tools.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Documented legacy behaviour with its own test ('validatePath allows all paths if roots are undefined (legacy)'), so closing it would change a covered contract rather than fix a bug.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a third output path parameter (e.g. headersFilePath) checked on its own line next to requestFilePath/responseFilePath
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the handler already validates two paths on two adjacent lines; a maintainer adding another 'save this part of the request to a file' option would copy that pattern, and a solver who trusts one of the two lines would miss it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: another context-layer read/write method (e.g. getHeapSnapshotEdges or a saveProcessedSnapshot) that reads a client path with no validatePath of its own
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: four sibling methods validate and this one did not at the pinned commit, so the maintainer pattern of adding a context API without the check already exists in the file.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an --output-file option for images returned by the CLI, writing to a caller-supplied path instead of the mkdtemp path
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the daemon client already materializes image content to disk with getTempFilePath + fs.writeFileSync at src/daemon/client.ts:177-178; exposing the destination is a one-line change with no root context in that process.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: install_extension_from_zip / reload where the unpacked directory is created at a client-supplied path
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: reload_extension already reaches the install path with a browser-reported path; adding a zip-install route that unpacks to a caller-chosen directory fits the existing shape.
